page.notes: Arabic passages were read at low resolution. Words marked [?] are doubtful, and the Arabic is not reliable letter by letter. The printed Latin "recensenda" and "ig-" (the broken word "ignorasse", continued by the catchword) are as printed. The Arabic word after "interdictum" is uncertain. The marginal references are "L.18." (beside the line about "diximus") and "v. supr. p. 52." (beside the line about the Latin version of the Alcoran). The Greek or Hebrew was not present on this page.
